headline: Kroger's identical sales barely grow (+0.2%) as pharmacy drug-price cuts and cautious shoppers bite; sales outlook cut.
guidance_note: Cut FY26 identical sales ex fuel to 0.2-0.8% (from 1-2%), incl. ~140bps IRA headwind; kept adj EPS $5.10-5.30 and FIFO op profit $5.0-5.2B.
key_messages: Identical sales ex fuel +0.2% (vs +3.4%), below ~0.9% expected; IRA Medicare drug price cuts cost ~138bps.
CFO cited ~265bps of combined drag: pharmacy, a Cyclospora produce outbreak, egg deflation and cautious spending.
Adjusted eCommerce sales +20%; retail media up 24%; Private Selection sales up more than 14%.
Gross margin 22.4% (vs 22.5%): fuel mix, shrink, freight and price investment offset by pharmacy mix and tariff refunds.
Adj EPS $1.09 (+5%); profit outlook held via cost savings.

consumer.pricing: Investing in lower prices; egg deflation hurt sales; tariff refunds aided margin; IRA cut pharmacy drug prices.

macro_read: Even grocery volumes are barely growing as households stay cautious on essentials; low food inflation and pharmacy price cuts hold nominal sales down.

sources.label: Reuters via WSAU: Kroger lowers annual identical sales forecast
